server_switch: No factory flag can downgrade sticky write_protocol=journal_v1. Enrollment is internal and explicit; no activation was performed.
activation: No runtime switch or live enrollment performed

writes.create: New queues default to legacy; exact existing plan replay reads only, never overwrites the sticky marker or recreates a protected row.
writes.claim: Guard before new claim; existing identical claim ACK is read-only and not dispatch authority.
writes.started: Guard before run binding, including same-run legacy entry.
writes.complete: Guard before new receipt/advance; immutable exact receipt readback precedes it.
writes.handoff_connection: Guard after immutable prior receipt branch, before ownership/resume writes.
writes.resolve_existing_run: Guard after immutable resolution replay, before advancing.
writes.skip_research: Guard after immutable skip replay, before skip/ownership/advance.
writes.release: Guard before release/lane write; already released replay reads only.
writes.repair_delivery: Guard after immutable repair receipt replay, before new delivery generation.
writes.pendingEvent: Guard before automatic delivery recovery/watchdog/cursor mutation or emitting legacy dispatch.
writes.markEventDelivered: Guard before new event/watchdog/ACK mutation; exact existing ACK readback is no-op.
writes.prepare_execution_attempt: Guard after exact permit replay, before new permit.
writes.enter_execution_attempt: Guard after exact entry replay; old entry readback work_authorized=false.
writes.bind_execution_attempt: Guard after exact association replay, before immutable association insert.

scope: All public Queue writes including execution trait are intrinsically guarded for marked queues, including raw/precreated objects. Healthy legacy rows need no journal store. External privileged SQL and Library ACLs are separate boundaries.
